spanish: Y no entrarán a ver como en tragar el santo, y morirán.

findings.issue: H6944 is a common noun (holiness / holy thing), singular; “el santo” turns the swallowed object into a person (saint/holy man).
כְּ plus the piel infinitive is one preposition; “en” adds a second preposition the token does not have.

notes: Negation, 3pl come-to-see, unmarked object marker, and sequential “y morirán” match the tokens.
